form: 4 IDENTICAL replicas of ot_hbm_su_pg_lane1_core (= pair k = lane k + bank k, k 0..3; each pair = ot_hbm_su_static_lane_pinreg + ot_hbm_su_static_pinned_bank with its 6 SRAM macros). The lanes4 core is 4 independent lane k <-> bank k pairs (member nets n_int join only lane k and bank k); the pairs share only broadcast INPUTS (lane0_* command/config bus 1414 b, bank0_rst_n, bank0_read_v[4], bank0_read_addr), which land on both sub-block faces. No sub-block <-> sub-block crossing.

sub_blocks.clock: regional clocks kept as pins: bank0_clk, bank0_clk_macro[5:0], lane0_clk_stage[7:0], lane0_clk_insert[3:0] (19 clock bits); face flops on bank0_clk

replica_map.u_p<k> k=1..3: bank<k>_* on its bank0_* pins (read_v = {bank0_read_v[4], bank<k>_read_v[3:0]}); lane<k> per-lane pins (clk_stage, clk_insert, rst_n, rd_q, lane_id, all outputs) on its lane0_* pins; shared: lane0_* broadcast inputs, bank0_rst_n, bank0_read_addr

rejected_forms.reason: 169k ORFS cells > 150k (census-scale 129k would pass; kept as the fewer-pins alternative: broadcast bus on 2 faces instead of 4)
